title: We Had the Date Wrong
sentences: For centuries, Pompeii's destruction had one date, but now that date is in doubt.
Copies of Pliny the Younger's letter put the eruption on the 24th of August, 79 AD.
But in 2018, archaeologists found a charcoal note on a wall in Pompeii.
It's dated the sixteenth day before the Kalends of November, which is October 17th.
If it was written in 79, the eruption came in autumn, perhaps on October 24th.
But the note has no year, so the date is still debated.
caption:
Was Pompeii destroyed in August or October? A charcoal note found in 2018 reopened the debate.
